glossary.def: Annual approved volume budget for each product and month.
The demand forecast you enter for each month. It is the number that will be submitted for approval.
Volume actually sold in the same month of the previous year. Used as a baseline to evaluate your forecast.
Percentage difference between the forecast and the reference (prior-year sales). It shows how far your forecast is from history — green up to 5%, amber up to 15%, red above that.
Monthly window in which the forecast is opened for entry, review and submission. Each cycle covers a range of future months.
Number of months between the current cycle and the period being forecast.
On the My Forecast screen, in export units, the "All countries" option shows the sum across all countries. It is read-only, for review — to edit, select a specific country.
A forecast generated automatically by statistical models. It can be accepted as a starting point and adjusted afterwards.
Shortcuts to fill several months at once: accept the AI suggestion, use a historical average, a fixed value, distribute a total or adjust by percentage.

gestor.title: How to fill in and submit your forecast
steps: Select the desired cycle in the cycle selector at the top of the My Forecast screen.
Expand a family and then a product to view the months.
Enter the forecast volume (FCST) for each month. The deviation from prior-year sales is shown alongside to guide you.
If you prefer, use the Quick actions to fill several months at once.
Review the family totals and click "Submit Cycle" to send for approval.

gestor.title: Export units: forecasting by country
steps: In export units, use the country selector next to the cycle selector.
On open, the screen already starts on a specific country — fill in its forecast normally.
The "All countries" option is a read-only consolidated view (sum of all countries), useful for review.
To edit the forecast or add/remove products, always select a specific country.
Repeat the entry for each country and submit the cycle at the end.

gestor.title: Using Quick actions
steps: Open the "Quick actions" menu in a family header.
Choose an option: accept the AI suggestion, fill with an average (3, 6 or 12 months), set a fixed value, distribute a total or adjust by percentage.
Check the preview of the changes before confirming.
After applying, you can still adjust individual months if needed.

gestor.title: Tracking the consolidated view
steps: Open the Consolidated screen to see totals aggregated by unit, family and country.
Use the window selector to change the analyzed period.
Compare FCST, BDG and Sales side by side and watch the color-highlighted deviations.
Expand the groups to investigate products with systematic deviation.
